_comment: What each employer's online application form actually asks for.
CAPTURED LIVE on 2026-09-11 by opening the real apply form in a browser and
enumerating its fields (the forms are JavaScript-rendered, so they cannot be
read with plain HTTP). Verified per EMPLOYER, not per job: every posting on
the same board submits through one identical form — only the job title at the
top changes. The 'verified_on' date says when that was last checked.
If a form changes, update 'fields' and bump 'verified_on'.

cv_upload.note: CV must be in the language of the job posting (English).

required_fields: How did you hear about us?
watch_out: Asks you to self-declare each language and your proficiency level — Kasi: English (fluent), Tamil (native), Hindi (basic).
MSC advises applying for only one or two best-fitting roles; more applications do not improve your chances.

cv_upload.note: Smaller limit than MSC — a 3MB CV will be rejected here. Can also import from LinkedIn, Dropbox, Indeed or OneDrive.

required_fields: Consent to use of personal information for recruiting
watch_out: Asks whether you have tattoos that would be visible in uniform — answer honestly; it is a screening question, not an automatic rejection.
CV size limit is 1MB. Kasi's current CV is ~111KB, so it is fine.
This employer's form has not been inspected yet — the fields above are the usual minimum, not a verified list.

_always_have_ready._comment: Documents Kasi should have scanned and to hand before starting any cruise application.
items: CV as a PDF under 1MB (the smallest limit seen across these boards)
Passport — number and expiry (his is valid to 2032)
CDC / Seaman's Book — number and expiry (his is valid to 2034)
Date of birth and full name exactly as printed in the passport
Phone number in international format, no spaces
Reference and employment dates from your current housekeeping role (May 2024 onwards)
B.Sc. Marine Catering & Hotel Management certificate
Any STCW basic safety training certificate, if obtained
